snippet.title: The Coffin Of Andrew And Renee Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Like mother, like daughter.

“The Coffin of Andrew and Renee” is a mod for TCOAAL. The Alternate Universe we are developing centers around the question: "What would happen to the timeline of events from the original game, if one aspect of their childhood was changed?". And thus, The Coffin of Andrew and Renee was born. 


In the universe of the Mod, Ashley is replaced with Renee Graves. The undertones from the original are twisted and tainted to explore a different type of co-dependency complex (oedipal). Our mod not only has a new storyline, but all brand new art, dialogue, maps, sprites, music, UI elements, and gameplay features. 


We aim to MOD all five episodes of TCOAAL into “The Coffin of Andrew and Renee” and look forward to your support of the project!
